# ShanghaiMed

> International medical concierge platform connecting global patients with Shanghai's 14 public Grade-A tertiary hospitals. Bilingual ISPN-certified nurses, 24/7 AI support, transparent pricing ($1,000-$1,650 concierge packages). Medical procedures cost 60-80% less than the US.

## Core Services

- **Free Initial Consultation**: Medical needs assessment, hospital/specialist recommendations, cost estimates, insurance guidance
- **Essential Care Concierge** ($1,000 USD / 3 days / up to 8h per day): Airport pickup, in-person medical accompaniment, interpretation, report translation, scheduling, medication coordination
- **Complex Care Concierge** ($1,650 USD / 5 days / up to 8h per day): Same services for complex medical procedures or multi-department visits
- **Half-Day Add-On** ($200 USD / 4 hours) and **Full-Day Add-On** ($350 USD / 8 hours)

Medical expenses are paid directly to hospitals. Concierge fees cover coordination and support services only.

## About

ShanghaiMed is an independent medical concierge service, not a medical provider. We are based in Shanghai, China, and serve international patients seeking world-class healthcare at competitive prices. Our team of ISPN-certified bilingual registered nurses provides end-to-end support from initial inquiry to post-treatment follow-up.
